व्रज् + अ, m.
 1. A road.

व्रण्, † i. 1, Par. To sound.

व्रण, n.
 1. A wound, Pañc. 170, 25.
 2. A fracture,

 --Comp.

व्रत (an old ptcple. of the pf. pass. of वृ), n.
 1. A (self-chosen) voluntary act,
; as fasting, continence, a vowed observance, a vow,

व्रात, probably व्रत + अ,
 I. m.
 1. The company and attendants at a marriage feast.
 2. An assemblage, a multitude, Bhāg.

. The son of an outcaste.
 II. n.
 1. Bodily labour.
 2. Day labour.
 --Comp.
व्रत-स्थ, adj., f. था, Engaged in religious austerities,
-व्रतिक, i. e. व्रत + इक in वक-, adj. Acting like a crane, hypocritic,

व्रतिन्, i. e. व्रत + इन्,
 I. adj. Engaged in a religious vow or obligation, pious, Pañc. i. d. 467.
 II. m.
 1. An employer of priests.
 2. An ascetic.
 3. A religious student,
व्रातीन, i. e. व्रत + ईन, m. A hired labourer, Bhaṭṭ. 4, 12.
